adminPanel.mail_help_overview_body: SMTP is the protocol used to send emails from the system (order notifications, complaints, password reset...). You need an email account or SMTP service (Gmail, Outlook, SendGrid, Mailgun...) to fill in the fields below.
adminPanel.mail_help_driver: Choose SMTP for most cases. Mailgun/SES only when separately configured on the server.
adminPanel.mail_help_host: SMTP server address. Examples: smtp.gmail.com, smtp.office365.com, smtp.mailgun.org.
adminPanel.mail_help_encryption: TLS for port 587, SSL for port 465. Choose None if the provider does not require encryption.
adminPanel.mail_help_username: Usually your login email or the username provided by your SMTP provider.
adminPanel.mail_help_password: Email password or App Password (Gmail/Outlook require App Password when 2FA is enabled).
adminPanel.mail_help_gmail_body: Host: smtp.gmail.com | Port: 587 | Encryption: TLS | Username: email@gmail.com | Password: 16-character App Password (create at Google Account → Security → App passwords).
adminPanel.mail_help_outlook_body: Host: smtp.office365.com | Port: 587 | Encryption: TLS | Username: email@outlook.com | Password: account password or App Password.
adminPanel.mail_help_test_body: Enter a test receiver email and click "Send Test Email". The system uses the values you just entered. On success, settings are saved automatically and shown when you return to this page. You can also click "Save changes" at the top to save without sending a test.
adminPanel.mail_help_tips_body:
• The "From" address comes from General → Store email.
• Leaving password blank when saving keeps the previously saved password.
• Check spam if you do not receive the test email.
adminPanel.mail_password_saved_hint: Password is saved. Leaving blank when saving keeps the existing value.
